Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for Bangladesh's reply. The Windies players stride out to the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto to open for Bangladesh. Alzarri Joseph to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

Right then! Should be an easy chase for Bangladesh! It is tough to bat but the visitors have a clear idea of what will come in front of them. West Indies have to do something exceptional to win this game. Stay tuned for the second innings.

Mehidy Hasan is up for a chat. He says the wicket is helping the spinner so he tried to bowl good areas and maintain a good line. Adds that the wicket is a bit slow and it is hard for the batters. Shares that they will try to chase this down. Tells that they need to be aggressive on this pitch and not think much.

West Indies have been bundled out for their second ever lowest total on home soil! What a dismal performance by them for the second time in a row. Except for Keemo Paul, none of the batters were able to cross the 20 run mark and this kind of display is unacceptable playing at the top level. They had no answers for the numerous questions thrown at them by the Bangladesh spinners and found it difficult to score runs as well as preserve the wickets. They will have to come up with an extraordinary bowling performance if they have to save this series.

Bangladesh won the toss and they seemed to have read the pitch bang on! 28 overs of the total 35 were bowled by their spinners. They were accurate, economical and almost unplayable at times and took 8 wickets between them. Nasum Ahmed was economical once again and took three wickets in what is his second ODI and Mehidy Hasan as he often does gets an abundance of wickets under his belt! They should be confident of extending their winning streak to 10 matches by the end of this game.

This has been an absolute annihilation by Bangladesh as West Indies had to face trial by spin! What a bowling performance from Bangladesh and they have restricted the hosts to a measly total of 108. Once again West Indies needed their last wicket partnership to push their total beyond 100 this time. That said, it doesn't look enough.

OUT! LBW! Hasan ends with a four-fer! Another appeal and the finger goes up! This time it looks like there is no bat! Floated, full and on middle and leg. Motie strides forward to defend but it angles in and pings him on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Motie reviews again. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracking shows umpire's call on wicket hitting. West Indies are all out on 108. Their second lowest score at home.
Flatter and outside off, straightens up. Motie defends the wrong line there.

Not out it is! A huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. There is a thick inside edge! Tossed up, angling around middle. Motie gets on his front foot to defend but seems to miss and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Motie reviews and Ultra Edge shows there is an inside edge.
A single taken! On the pads, flicked to square leg for one. Now, Bangladesh can attack to Motie.
A loopy ball outside off. Defended out.
FOUR! Good start by Paul! Tossed up on off, turning in. Paul steps across and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Runs coming for West Indies now.
A slower length ball on middle. Blocked out.
Too full and outside off. Paul steers it to third man for a single.
A length ball, angling across, outside off. Paul looks to drive but misses.
Fuller and on off, Paul drives it to deep cover for a brace.
FOUR! Much needed! On a length and again on the pads. Paul gets on his knee and sweeps it aerially over square leg for a boundary. 100 up.
Fuller and on the pads, Paul turns it to square leg.

EDGED AND FOUR! A loopy ball, angling in outside off, turning away. Motie prods to defend but gets a thick outside edge to first slip where the fielder dives to his right but it bounces in front of him and evades to race to the fence.
Flatter and on middle. Paul tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single. Motie has one ball to survive.
Tossed up on off. Paul prods and defends it to point.
Shorter ball on middle. Paul blocks it.
Shorter, spinning in on middle. Paul rocks back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, nudged to mid-wicket.
Short once again and in line with the stumps, Keemo Paul works this through square leg for a single.
Full toss on the stumps and Gudakesh Motie knocks it back straight past the bowler. The fielder at mid on cuts it off to restrict the batters to a single.
This one is delivered short outside off, Keemo Paul guides this to third man for a single.
Shoriful Islam serves this on a good length on the pads, Gudakesh Motie works this towards mid-wicket and rushes across for a single.
Full delivery angled into the pads, Keemo Paul looks to glance but goes off the pads towards fine leg for a leg bye.
A length ball on top of off. Paul blocks it out.
Angles a full ball on middle. Motie tucks it to square leg. A single is available but Paul wants the strike.
Again flights it up, full and on middle, extra bounce. Motie looks to block but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Too full, flighted and on middle. Motie blocks it out solidly.
Gudakesh Motie is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Back-to-back wickets for Mehidy Hasan! The magic of spin has got West Indies in a muddle! Mehidy Hasan serves a quick delivery full and outside off, Alzarri Joseph hangs his bat out and gets a faint edge to the keeper. Nurul Hasan takes a sharp catch behind the wicket and West Indies find themselves 9 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Alzarri Joseph walks out to bat.
OUT! TIMBER! Hasan strikes again! Tossed up, outside off, this one spins sharply in. Shepherd tries to reverse sweep but misses and the ball rattles the stumps. West Indies 8 down now.
Tossed up on off, drifting in. Shepherd watchfully blocks it.
Short and wide this time, Romario Shepherd plays this late through backward point for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Keemo Paul knocks this towards long on for single.
Full delivery on off, Keemo Paul gets a stride forward and fends it. Hits the gloves and goes toward point.
Outside off, pushed to sweeper cover for a run.
Shorter and outside off. Shepherd punches it to covers.
Nasum Ahmed flights a full delivery angling into the pads, Romario Shepherd knocks this back to the bowler.

FOUR! Two in a row! Rare one for the Windies! This is short and outside off. Paul punches hard off the back foot through covers and the fielder gives a chase but to no avail as the ball races into the fence.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is full and outside off. Paul reverse sweeps it to deep backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Shepherd skips down but ends up dragging it to deep square leg for a single.
Pitched up on middle, Shepherd hits it to mid on.
Drops it short, on middle, stays low, it is pushed to mid on.
Slower through the air on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Pushes it through on middle. Paul works it to mid-wicket.
SHorter and outside off, width there and Shepherd slaps it through covers for a single.
On off, kept out.
An arm ball, fuller and around middle and leg. Shepherd looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but nothing given. Probably going down.
BEATEN! Tossed up on off, spins a bit away. Shepherd prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Pitched up on middle. Paul sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Romario Shepherd walks out now.

OUT! Hosein is RUN OUT! For the second game in a row! Again was it necessary considering the position the Windies are! On the pads, Paul flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg. There was never a single there but the batters run across and Hosein was short of his crease as Hasan clips the bails off. Hosein knew he was short there! Perfect throw from Mustafizur Rahman there.
Keemo Paul is the next batter in.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Brandon King's long stay doesn't trouble Bangladesh as he goes for just 11 runs! Soft dismissal! He did all the hard work just to get out at the wrong time! Hasan tosses it up, around middle and off. King comes down the track and tries to play the spin but it holds a bit in the surface and doesn't spin much. It beats the outside edge before rattling the stump. West Indies six down now.
Slowes it up, outside off. Hosein punches it to Hasan who lets it through his hands and to long off for a single.
Flatter and outside off. King punches off the back foot to the left of mid off for a single.
Touch short and outside off. Hosein punches it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked to mid-wicket.

Wow! A beauty of a delivery from Islam! Angles a length ball on middle, there is bounce and nips away off the deck. King defends the wrong line and is surprised by the bounce. It lobs over the middle stump.
Touch fuller and outside off. King cuts it straight to point.
A slower full ball on middle. King blocks it.
Length ball, slanting outside off. King leaves it alone.

OUT! TAKEN! The 24-run stand is broken! Rovman Powell will be disappointed here! This is on a length and on middle, there is steep bounce and it holds a bit as well. Powell looks to work on the leg side as he swings across but it goes from the higher part of the blade and in the air, Mahmudullah at mid-wicket, takes the skier with ease. Akeal Hosein walks out to the middle.
Fuller and angling on middle. King eases it to mid on and takes a quick single.
This one is flighted slower in the air, served full outside off, Rovman Powell strides forward and plays it down into the pitch.
Quick once again but served full this time in line with the stumps. Rovman Powell knocks this back to the bowler.

WIDE! Mosaddek Hossain fires this one quick and angling down leg from a shorter length, Rovman Powell looks to play this fine and misses. So does Nurul Hasan as the ball rolls towards fine leg for the batters to take two more runs.
This is served full and on an off stump line, Rovman Powell knocks this towards mid-wicket.
Short once again outside off, Brandon King comes down the wicket to knock it towards long on for a single.
This time goes short in line with the stumps, Brandon King works this towards square leg.
Full delivery turning in from outside off, Brandon King pushes at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a good length again outside off, Brandon King dabs the ball to cover and takes a single.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Brandon King gets behind the line of the ball and hits it to short cover.
This is on a good length and angling in from outside off, Brandon King gets beaten on his inside edge.
Shoriful Islam serves this full outside off, Rovman Powell plays it with soft hands towards cover-point and rushes across for a single.
Goes a fraction full outside off, Brandon King works this towards third man and gets a run.
Shoriful Islam begins with a good length delivery outside off, Rovman Powell guides this through cover-point for a single.
Shoriful Islam is into the attack.
Shorter and around off, quicker. King hangs back to tuck it to mid-wicket.
Quick delivery served full and on middle, Rovman Powell sweeps hard and a half stop at square leg allows the batters to take a single.

FOUR! That should release some pressure! Full delivery outside off, Rovman Powell comes down the wicket and tries to thump this straight. Manages to slice this over extra cover and it runs away for four runs!
Full and outside off, Rovman Powell takes a stride forward and defends firmly.
Full delivery in line with the stumps, Brandon King goes to sweep and hits it on the bounce to the deep square leg fielder.
Slightly short and on off. King works it to covers.
Flatter and outside off. Powell tries to push with soft hands but again there is turn and it goes off the outside edge to first slip.
A loopy ball, around the off pole. Powell keeps it out.
Beautifully bowled! Flighted ball, full and around off, spins away. Powell strides forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up on middle. Powell defends it.
FOUR! Tossed up, on the pads. Powell sweeps it fine to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out.
Wide! Slides it down the leg side, spins back in but Powell fails to sweep it away.
Full delivery turning inf from outside off, Brandon King looks to work this leg side and gets struck on the pads.
Short and in line with the stumps, Brandon King goes back and defends back to the bowler.
Goes full this time and angles it in from off, Rovman Powell gets this wide off square leg for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain goes short again outside off, Brandon King manages to play this through backward point for a single.
Slightly short and in line with the stumps, Brandon King taps this back towards the bowler.
Mosaddek Hossain floats this full in line with the stumps, Rovman Powell works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Sharp turn there! Tossed up, outside off and spinning away. King defends inside the line and gets beaten. Another maiden for Nasum Ahmed.
Floated full and on middle. King lunges and blocks it out.
Fuller and on off. Kept out.
A loopy ball on off. King drops it to point and stays behind. Powell meanwhile wants a quick single but it was not available and he charges back to get inside.
Too full and on off. King defends it out.
Tossed up, slanting on leg. King watchfully blocks it.
Too full and floated, on off. Powell again blocks it.
Tossed up on off, turning in. Powell blocks it on the front foot.
Shorter and outside off. King punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up on middle. King blocks it out.
Floats this one full and outside off, Brandon King hits this firmly towards mid off.
Mosaddek Hossain fires this full into the pads, Brandon King goes back and defends solidly.
Rovman Powell comes in.

OUT! BOWLED! Nicholas Pooran goes without troubling the scorer! He goes on a golden duck! Not quite sure if this shot was needed at this stage with spin and grip for the bowler! Ahmed serves a flatter ball, outside off, it stays a bit low. Nicholas Pooran tries to reverse sweep but gets hit on thegloves and the ball ricochets onto the stumps. The leg pole shatteres and Nasum Ahmed celebrates again. What a game he is having.
Shorter and outside off. King slaps it to deep cover for a single.

Drinks! What a performance from Bangladesh already! The spinners have been superb till now. There is turn and grip for them and they are bowling very tight and not giving anything away. West Indies are in real trouble here and Nicholas Pooran and Brandon King need to do the repair work now.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is the end of a labored innings from Shai Hope! Nasum Ahmed flights this full and in line with the stumps, Shai Hope goes to sweep at it and gets a thick top edge! The ball goes high up and there is breeze taking the ball away from the fielder but Mosaddek Hossain at mid-wicket does well to judge this runnning back and take it with ease! Shai Hope never looked comforatble on the wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Mosaddek Hossain b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Another full delivery flighted outside off, Shai Hope goes forward to smother it in defense.
Quicker delivery served full outside off, Brandon King pushes for it and gets a thick edge that goes in the vacant slip area towards short third man. The batters complete a single.
Nasum Ahmed begins with a flighted delivery full and outside off, Shai Hope works this through covers for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain tosses this on full and in line with the stumps, Brandon King comes down the wicket and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and angling into middle, Brandon King works this towards mid-wicket.
Mosaddek Hossain serves this full outside off, Shai Hope reaches for it and plays it towards long off for a single.
Full outside off angling into the stumps, Shai Hope keeps this out and plays it towards cover.
Full delivery angling down leg, Shai Hope looks to flick and misses as it hits his pads.
Flighted full outside off, Shai Hope plays inside the line off the ball and gets beaten.
So, third maiden for Ahmed! Flatter and on off. King waits and guides it to point.
Again tight from Ahmed, giving nothing away! This is really superb from him! On off, blocked out.
Tossed up on off. King gets on the front foot to block it out.
This one comes with the angle, length and on leg, bounces as well. King stays back to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A stifled appeal follows but nothing given.
Slants a full ball, around middle and leg. King again blocks it.
Tossed up, slanting on off. King lunges and keeps it out.
Flighted full and in line of the stumps, Shai Hope strides forward and defends down the pitch.
Sharp turn into the batter from off, Shai Hope looks to work it leg side and misses, gets so pad on it as it rolls to the leg side.
Full delivery outside off, Brandon King gets down the wicket and hits this in the air to the left of mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, fuller and it is blocked by King.
Flatter and just outside off. Hope pushes it to point for a run.
Fuller and on off, pushed to covers.
Flatter and outside off, punched straight back to the bowler.
Brandon King is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Nasum Ahmed gets his man! A lovely delivery from him to get rid of Brooks! Ahmed angles a length ball, around off, it comes with the angle. Brooks played all over it as he tries to cut but misses and the off pole is rattled.
Fuller and on middle. Brooks prods and defends it out solidly.
FOUR! This one is spanked over mid-wicket! Full delivery angling into the pads, Shamarh Brooks uses his wrists and lofts it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary! Nice looking short there!
This one is tossed up full on the pads, Shai Hope works this through backward square leg for a single.
Quick delivery fired in full from outside off, Shai Hope gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Short ball, outside off. Brooks cuts it hard but again can't find the gap. Straight to the point fielder.
Wide! Shorter but down the leg side. Brooks tries to pull but misses.
Fuller ball on middle. Brooks tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full delivery flighted through the air, Shai Hope works this to long on for a single.

FOUR! This is really fine! Mosaddek Hossain delivers this short as well and outside off, Shai Hope slashes hard and gets a thick outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary! Shai Hope opened the face of his bat but he must not have meant for it to go so fine!
Mosaddek Hossain serves this a fraction short but quick and coming into the batter, Shai Hope manages to work this towards square leg.
Flights this one full in line with the stumps, Shai Hope flicks this towards mid-wicket.
Quicker delivery fired in full outside off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this hard towards cover.
Nasum Ahmed gets this one to nip off the wicket and turn. The ball is delivered full outside off, Shamarh Brooks pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge that falls just short of the slip fielder.
Short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks leaves this one alone.
Another leading edge as Shamarh Brooks is not being able to read the spin. Full and in line with the stumps, goes towards point once more.
Short and outside off, Shamarh Brooks slashes it hard straight to the point fielder.
Nasum Ahmed serves this full outside off, Shamarh Brooks looks to work it leg side and gets a leading edge towards point.
This is served full outside off, Shai Hope has to adjust and keep the ball out as it keeps a fraction low.
Full and angled in from outside off, Shamarh Brooks knocks this towards long on and gets off the mark with a single.
Flights this one full and angling into the pads, Shamarh Brooks works this towards square leg.
Shamarh Brooks is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Bangladesh have their first breakthrough! Mosaddek Hossain fires one in full on off, Kyle Mayers plays inside the line of the delivery as the ball angles away and hits the stumps! Kyle Mayers was living a charmed life and has to finally make the long walk back!
Mosaddek Hossain goes short outside off, Shai Hope rocks back and punches it past the cover fielder for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain starts off with a full delivery angling into the pads, Shai Hope flicks this towards mid-wicket.
That is the end of Powerplay 1! Bangladesh can keep four fielders outside the inner circle now till the 40th over. Also, Mosaddek Hossain is back on.
Floated on middle. Mayers blocks it to mid-wicket. That was an eventful over! The spinners have kept very tight from both the ends.
A huge appeal for LBW but not given! Angles a length ball, around middle and leg. Mayers tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. It was clearly sliding down.
Quicker, fuller and around off, very tight. Mayers was rooted in his crease as he tries to flick it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. Was very close to the off pole as well.
A single as Hope drives this full ball to deep extra cover.
A full ball on middle. Hope pushes it to mid on.
Beaten! Beautifully bowled! Tosses it up, outside off. Hope lunges to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up, it drifts in and around off. Mayers prods to defend but gets hit on the pads. Mehidy Hasan was interested in some while to review it but there was a clear inside edge.
Tossed up on off, Mayers hangs back to push to covers.
On off, blocked out.
Good delivery! Fuller ball, outside off, there is drift and turn. Mayers is tempted to drive it but misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mayers drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
A loopy ball, outside off. Mayers looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the leg side.

Good review from Hope! Ahmed tosses it up nicely, fuller and around off, it lands and spins away. Hope strides forward to defend but misses and Hasan pouches it. An appeal for caught behind and it is given. Hope reviews it straightaway. Ultra Edge shows a spike but that was off the bat hitting the ground. Not out it is!
Tossed up, outside off. Hope blocks it towards point.
A full toss around off. Hope gets low and tries to sweep but finds mid on. Should have scored on that. It was a juicy full toss.
Floated ball on off, driven straight to covers.
Slides a full ball on the pads. Hope tries to defend on the front foot but gets hit on the pads.
An arm ball, flatter and on off. Hope chops it on the off side.
Hasan serves it on leg. Hope turns it to mid-wicket for one more. West Indies have calmed things down after a bit of a shaky start. The good thing is they haven't lost any wickets yet.
On middle, kept out.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Mayers has to reach for it, he tries to drive but gets a thick outside edge to point. Drops safe.
Flatter and on the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted, full and on leg. Mayers bunts it to square leg for one more.
Short of a length and on the hips. Mayers nudges it to square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed to the left of mid off for a single.
Leg bye! Tries a slower yorker but the line is on the pads. Mayers tucks it to square leg for a leg bye as it came off the pads.
Length and on top of off. Mayers stays back and guides it to point.
Fuller ball on the pads. Mayers eases it to mid on.
A length ball, outside off, pushed to covers.
Mehidy Hasan goes full on middle, Shai Hope uses the crease and goes back to defend the ball back down the pitch.
Goes quick once again outside off, Shai Hope hits this straight to cover.
This one is delivered quicker on a full length and angled into the pads, Shai Hope guides this to mid-wicket once again.
Mehidy Hasan drifts this in full on middle, Shai Hope works this towards mid-wicket.

Ohh dear, Nurul Hasan has made a mess of an easy stumping chance. Hope was well out of his crease. The fielding still remains an issue for Bangladesh. A couple of run out chances and now a big stumping chance.

That is a missed stumping!! How costly is this going to be for Bangladesh! Mehidy Hasan flights this one full outside off, Shai Hope charges down the wicket and tries to loft this but plays for the spin and misses the line of the ball! Nurul Hasan makes an absolute mess as he spills the ball and knocks the stumps out with his gloves! Not only did he miss the stumping, looks like there was an edge! So that is a dropped catch and a missed stumping! Oh my!
Mehidy Hasan begins with a full delivery angling into the pads, Kyle Mayers gets a thick edge towards square leg for a single.
Change. Mehidy Hasan is brought into the attack.
Back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Kyle Mayers guides this towards third man for a single.
Wide outside off from a good length, Kyle Mayers slashes at it and is beaten.
Attempts a slower yorker this time but ends up as a full toss in line with the stumps. Kyle Mayers blocks this back to the bowler.
Full once again outside off, Kyle Mayers fends this towards mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman goes full on middle, with shape into the batter, Shai Hope works this to the right of mid on for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman begins with a full delivery swinging in from outside off, Shai Hope taps it towards cover.
Four! That is timed well. Shorter and outside off. Mayers punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Just short! Tossed up on off. Mayers looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat to mid on and it bounces well in front of him.
Flatter and outside off. Mayers punches it to sweeper cover for two more.
on middle, Hope comes down the track and smashes it to long on for one more. Not timed well.
Tossed up, on off. Hope blocks it out.
Mosaddek Hossain flights this in from outside off, Shai Hope gets across and defdns this down the pitch.
Kyle Mayers has some issues with his ankle. His right ankle as he tries to complete the single. The physio is out to assess him. A bit of strapping has been done.

Miscommunication once again! Some poor running between the wicket here! Kyle Mayers once again goes looking for a quick single as he taps full delivery outside off towards cover. Shai Hope refuses the single this time and Kyle Mayers is stranded half way down the pitch. The throw misses the stumps and the diving keeper and Kyle Mayers is not even in the frame! Injures himself trying to get back!

Mustafizur Rahman angles this in from outside off on a good length. Kyle Mayers taps this towards covers and calls for a run. There is some hesitation but Shai Hope has committed and has to dive to make it back in. The throw misses the stumps and he would have probably been gone if it had hit!
Edged and just short! Full once again and outside off, Kyle Mayers gets the outside edge but the ball falls just short of Nurul Hasan as he dives forward behind the wicket.

Mustafizur Rahman angles this one into the pads, Kyle Mayers looks to flick it leg side and gets a slight inside edge onto his pads. There is a huge appeal and Tamim Iqbal is enquiring whether to review. The timer clocks out and replays confirm the inside edge.
This one is served outside off and on a good length, Kyle Mayers goes for the drive and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Mustafizur Rahman starts off with a full delivery on middle, Shai Hope gets his bat down in time and gets a thick inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman to start from the other end.
Too full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full once again and outside off, Kyle Mayers knocks this straight to covers.
Mosaddek Hossain goes wide from off stump and full, Kyle Mayers swings and misses.
Full and in line with the stumps, Kyle Mayers defends this back down the pitch.
FOUR! First boundary for West Indies! This is served full outside off, Kyle Mayers goes to hit this through offside and gets a thick outside edge that flies to backward point for a boundary!
Mosaddek Hossain begins with a flighted delivery full and outside off, Shai Hope flicks this towards square leg and gets off the mark with a single.

We are all set for the action. Beautiful weather so far in Guyana. The Bangladeshi players are out in the middle. Kyle Mayers and Shai Hope are the openers for the Windies. The West Indies players take a knee to support the BLM movement while the opposition stands in solidarity. Mosaddek Hossain to start with the ball. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Stacy-Ann King is pitchside. She says there was some early morning rain but there is sunshine right now. Regarding the pitch, she says this is the same pitch as the third T20I. Adds that it is solid and there is grass and bit of cracks. Expects some seam movement as well.

So, Keemo Paul, who tested positive for Covid during the first game is back in the XI while Alzarri Joseph is back as well for West Indies. While on the other side, Bangladesh have opted for an extra batter as Taskin Ahmed makes way for Mosaddek Hossain.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Kyle Mayers, Shai Hope (WK), Shamarh Brooks, Brandon King, Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Keemo Paul (In for Anderson Phillip), Romario Shepherd, Akeal Hosein, Gudakesh Motie, Alzarri Joseph (In for Jayden Seales).

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mehidy Hasan, Mosaddek Hossain (In for Taskin Ahmed), Nasum Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

West Indies need to win this game to keep the series alive. They have the ability but need to be more composed on a pitch that doesn’t favour batters much. Bangladesh have the momentum and their bowlers have done an amazing job for them till now. They will hope for something similar from them while the Windies will hope they can produce a good all-round performance to level the series. Will the visitors seal the series or the hosts will bounce back? Or the rain gods will play a part again. All your questions will be answered soon. Stay tuned for further updates.
